[[File:ma smuni zo le.png|thumb|pa brasmani cu pensi lo smuni be zo le]]''Hermeneutics'' is the theory of text interpretation, especially philosophical and religious texts and wisdom literature. The terms "''hermeneutics''" and "''exegesis''" are sometimes used interchangeably. Hermeneutics is a wider discipline that includes written, verbal, and nonverbal communication. Exegesis focuses primarily upon texts.

''Hermeneutics'' is what Lojbanists have been doing for a long time. Instead of creating new words with meanings they can explain Lojbanists have been involved in the activity of trying to decipher either broken definitions of [[gismu]] and [[cmavo]] or those written by unreachable people.

See {{jvs|ermenefti}}.
